findings.evidence: DOM order: s3-step3 with style="order:3", s3-step2 with style="order:2", s3-step1 with style="order:1". Screen reader encounters steps as Confirm your order, Enter payment details, Choose a plan.
findings.violation: The DOM source order does not match the visual order produced by CSS order properties. Screen reader users encounter wizard steps in reverse sequence (Confirm, Enter payment, Choose) instead of logical sequence (Choose, Enter payment, Confirm).
findings.fix: Reorder the HTML source so step1 div appears first, then step2, then step3. Remove or adjust the inline order properties. Alternatively, use aria-flowto to explicitly link steps in correct sequence.

findings.evidence: Error. with no aria-describedby on the input field at line 67
findings.violation: The error message conveys only 'Error.' with no explanation of what validation failed, what value is expected, or how to correct the input. The error span is not linked to the input using aria-describedby, so a screen reader user cannot connect the error to the field.
findings.fix: Replace message with specific actionable text like 'Promo code must contain only letters and numbers.' Add aria-describedby="s3-form-promo-error" to the promo input element.

findings.evidence: ; div has no role, tabindex, aria-label, or keyboard handlers
findings.violation: A visually styled interactive control (delete icon) lacks role attribute, keyboard focus support (tabindex), accessible name (aria-label), and keyboard event handlers. It is not operable by keyboard-only users or properly labeled for screen readers.
findings.fix: Either convert to <button aria-label="Delete"></button>, or add role="button", tabindex="0", aria-label="Delete" to the div and implement Enter/Space key handlers.

findings.evidence: <label for="phone" id="s3-form-phone-label" style="color:#cc0000">Phone number</label>; red color (#cc0000) is sole indicator of required status
findings.violation: Color alone signals that the Phone number field is required. Users with color blindness or using high-contrast display settings cannot perceive the red color signal; the text 'Phone number' does not indicate required status.
findings.fix: Add visible text indicator such as ' (required)' or an asterisk with aria-label="required" next to the label text.
